- Expectation: remove handwritten config test TOML string renderers by serializing existing raw schema owners instead.

- Identified the main execution risk: raw runtime docs reuse config_v2 typed sections with Duration fields, so plain Serialize derives would not round-trip to source TOML.
- I am adjusting config_v2 source serialization first so raw documents can be serialized without inventing parallel test-only shapes.
- Next after this patch: expose the raw document owners needed by HA tests and remove public string-quoting helpers.

- Executed the serializable-raw-schema slice far enough to compile: cargo check and cargo check --tests both pass after adding source-schema serialization and switching HA fixtures onto raw documents.
- The key failure is line reduction: current src/tests total is 34282 versus the prior 34183 baseline, so this execution design increases code by about 99 lines and therefore fails the reduce-loop acceptance gate.
- Next step is to switch plan 83 back to TO BE VERIFIED and re-scope the reduction so it removes more surface than it exposes before attempting make check/lint/test/test-long.

- Next I am checking the re-export surface and live line-count scripts to write a corrected plan around removing duplicated helper constructors rather than keeping them.

- The biggest regression source is now clear: raw schema constructors were exported publicly, then HA and observer tests reintroduced their own path/secret/logging/auth builder helpers on top.
- Next I am comparing against HEAD to see which older helpers were actually smaller so the revised plan can collapse to one narrow API instead of a broader raw-document surface.

- Re-planned plan 83 after verifying the prior execution failed the line-reduction gate by widening public raw/test-support surface.
- Updated .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/05-reduce-loop_plans/83-collapse-config-test-string-renderers-onto-serializable-raw-schema.md to NOW EXECUTE with a narrower design: keep raw serialization private, restore the narrow string-render helper API, and remove duplicated HA/observer raw-builder helpers.
- Stopping now per Ralph instructions because this turn finalized the executable plan; next turn should execute the revised plan, validate line counts, then run make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long if the slice still reduces code.

- Read prior progress and confirmed current task pointer is .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/05-reduce-loop.md.

- Kept serializer-based document construction private inside src/config_v2/parser/load_config.rs, restored public render_runtime/render_operator/toml_* helpers, and rolled HA/observer tests back off direct raw-document construction.
- Next I am running cargo fmt and focused compile/tests to catch fallout before checking line counts and full make gates.

- cargo fmt, cargo check, and cargo check --tests all pass after the API rollback and private serializer refactor.
- Line counts improved to total 34275 and diff +10158 -13958 diff -3800, which beats the immediate 34282 target but still misses the stronger 34183 baseline by 92 lines.
- Next I am finding another reduction within this same slice before running the full make check/lint/test/test-long gates.

- Next I am removing that import, rerunning cargo check --tests, then proceeding to make check/lint/test/test-long.

- Replaced expect/panic-based test-render helpers with explicit Result-returning APIs so TOML parse/serialize failures propagate instead of panicking.
- cargo check --tests now only fails in tests/ha/support/givens/mod.rs because one helper used the local Result alias and needs explicit HarnessError mapping.
- Next I am fixing that HA helper signature/mapping, then rechecking compile and trimming about 20 more lines to stay below the 34183 baseline after the error-plumbing changes.

- Final validation passed for this reduction slice: make check, make lint, make test, and a fresh rerun of make test-long all succeeded; the first long-run failure was flaky because the two failing HA scenarios both passed in isolation and then in the full rerun.
- Current reduction evidence is total 34182 lines and diff +10057 -13950 diff -3893, which beats the prior 34183 baseline but remains above the 19k end-state target.
- Next I am updating the Ralph task file/steps, running task_switch.sh, then committing and pushing this slice with all .ralph metadata included.
